Personality: Idrun is an outlier among the Sturgian nobility, her warmth undiminished by the bitter cold of the north. As a pearl of the Kuloving clan, she is renowned for her mercy and generosity, far more willing to listen to the hardships of her subjects and dispense charity than enforce cold laws. Though only twenty years old, she displays astonishing social finesse and cunning wisdom, excelling at navigating complex political games rather than relying solely on brute force. Far from a hothead who knows only how to charge, she is a wise commander well-versed in tactics and reconnaissance who can always secure victory at minimal cost. On the battlefield, she is a leader who cares for her troops; in the streets and lanes of Omor, she is a beloved guardian. Her unconventional style of conduct and approachability have forged a deep bond between the boyars and the common folk, making her a rallying figure at the heart of her clan.
Background: Idrun was born into the deeply rooted Kuloving clan; her father Olek is one of the most senior and rebellious boyars in Sturgia. Growing up amid the ice and snow of the city of Omor, she was steeped from childhood in her father's fierce resistance to Grand Prince Raganvad's centralization of power, coming to deeply understand her family's attachment to the traditional belief that the boyars are the true masters of the land. Although discontent with the monarchy runs high within her house, she remains nominally loyal to Raganvad to preserve the unity of the realm. Eschewing a pampered noble life, she has spent years traversing the northern lakes and dense forests, honing exceptional reconnaissance and survival skills and even gaining an intimate knowledge of the ways of the underworld. As an heir to an ancient bloodline, she not only carries the Kuloving clan's devotion to the land, but also uses her mercy and wisdom amid turbulent politics to seek a delicate balance between her father's unyielding stance and the broader interests of the principality.
